description: Changes a Content Autopilot task's rules, schedule, clients or AI guidance; fields you leave out stay as they are. Use when the user wants to edit an automation. Not for turning it on or off (use set_autopilot_task_state); how it makes content and what it makes cannot change (create a new task). Returns the updated task. Overwrites the saved settings; lists replace the old list.

assign_to_client_user_ids.description: Client user IDs who get each new item assigned, up to 100. Get them from list_clients.

category_ids.description: Workout category IDs to pick from, up to 50. Workout tasks. Get them from list_workout_categories.

custom_prompt_guidance.description: Notes for the AI, up to 2000 characters, e.g. "Low impact, no jumping". Used with custom, ai_tuned and ai_driven.

difficulty_options.description: Levels each run picks from, 1 to 3 of beginner, intermediate, advanced, e.g. ["beginner", "intermediate"].

duration_max.description: Longest length: minutes for workouts, weeks for programs. At least 1, at least duration_min.

duration_min.description: Shortest length: minutes for workouts, weeks for programs. At least 1, at most duration_max.

exclude_exercise_collections.description: Never use exercises from these collections. Up to 50 exercise collection names, matched case-insensitively, e.g. ["Kettlebell"]. Workout tasks only (ai_generate, create_similar). Cannot be combined with the other collection list.

goal_ids.description: Program goal IDs to pick from, up to 50. Program tasks. Get them from list_team_goals.

include_exercise_collections.description: Only use exercises from these collections. Up to 50 exercise collection names, matched case-insensitively, e.g. ["Kettlebell"]. Workout tasks only (ai_generate, create_similar). Cannot be combined with the other collection list.

include_free_stock.description: Use Hyperhuman's free stock exercises. Backend default on create: true.

include_premium_stock.description: Use premium stock exercises. Needs premium stock on the plan. Backend default on create: false.

include_team_content.description: Use the team's own exercises (and team workouts for programs). Backend default on create: false.

name.description: Task name shown in Teams, up to 200 characters, e.g. "Weekly AI workout".

next_run_at.description: First (or next) run, as an ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. "2026-12-01T09:00:00Z". The run starts at the top of the hour at or after it. Omit to run when the task is activated.

programming_guideline.description: Programming guideline the AI follows: auto = the team's best-matching saved guideline; none = no guideline; explicit = the one in programming_guideline_id. Not used by publish_existing tasks.

programming_guideline_id.description: ID of a saved programming guideline (Teams > Workout defaults > Programming). Needed when programming_guideline is explicit; setting it alone implies explicit.

prompt_guidance_mode.description: Extra direction for the AI: none = task rules only; custom = adds custom_prompt_guidance; ai_tuned = adds the team's last 30 days of stats (plus custom_prompt_guidance if set); ai_driven = AI also picks level, category or goal and length from those stats (ai_generate tasks). Backend default: none.

repeat_mode.description: How often the task runs: once, daily, weekly, biweekly (every 2 weeks) or monthly.

repeat_until.description: Last day the task repeats, as an ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. "2027-03-31T23:59:59Z". Omit to repeat with no end. Ignored for once.

task_id.description: ID of the autopilot task. Get it from list_autopilot_tasks.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone that keeps the run at the same local time, e.g. "Europe/Bucharest". Omit to keep the UTC time.

workouts_per_week_max.description: Most workouts per week, 1 to 7, at least workouts_per_week_min. Program tasks only.

workouts_per_week_min.description: Fewest workouts per week, 1 to 7. Program tasks only.

name: update_autopilot_task
title: Update content automation
